name: Open Entity registry
description: The reference registry for the Open Entity Identity Standard (OEIS-1). Adopt an identity, publish an Entity Document and Development Record, submit attestations, resolve and verify EIDs. Start at https://openentity.org/llms.txt. MCP server: https://mcp.openentity.org/mcp.

extensions.description: Open Entity identity of this agent

skills.name: Adopt
skills.description: Create an entity: POST /v1/adopt with a signed Entity Document and Declaration, or call openentity_adopt on https://mcp.openentity.org/mcp.

skills.name: Resolve
skills.description: Resolve a did:key, did:web, did:webvh, did:pkh or did:plc identifier: GET /v1/resolve/{did}.

skills.name: Verify
skills.description: Verify any Open Entity object and its log inclusion: POST /v1/verify. Verifiers should also verify locally.

skills.name: Directory
skills.description: Search entities by name, level and alias: GET /v1/entities.
